name: split_overhead_fraction
rationale: Each split-K slice repeats the pipeline prologue/epilogue and the serial fix-up; relative to the iterations a slice runs, this grows with split_k and stages. Unlike pipeline_fill_drain_fraction and mainloop_iteration_count it does see split_k.

name: sm_idle_fraction
rationale: SM coverage without the max_blocks_per_sm factor, so lowering occupancy cannot look like more parallelism (wave_count_deficit rewards 1-block/SM configs).

name: serial_fixup_traffic_ratio
rationale: Serial split-K reads and writes the partial output tile once per extra slice.

name: log_quantized_work_ratio
code:
def log_quantized_work_ratio(p, hw, cfg) -> float:
    """log2 of the critical-path work one SM executes (wave-quantized, occupancy-shared, padded tiles and K slices) over the ideal M*N*K/SM. Larger is worse."""
    ctas = math.ceil(p.M / max(1, cfg.tile_m)) * math.ceil(p.N / max(1, cfg.tile_n)) * max(1, cfg.split_k)
    blocks = max(1, cfg.max_blocks_per_sm)
    kslice = math.ceil(p.K / max(1, cfg.tile_k * max(1, cfg.split_k))) * cfg.tile_k
    crit = math.ceil(ctas / (hw.sm_count * blocks)) * blocks * cfg.tile_m * cfg.tile_n * kslice
    return math.log2(max(1.0, crit / max(1.0, p.M * p.N * p.K / hw.sm_count)))
rationale: Wave quantization, occupancy sharing, edge padding and per-slice K padding folded into one critical-path work ratio; the split-K left side of the V.
